lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a lattice-like arrangement of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper flank, defined by a distinct sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of each ridge and shadow on the ventral side.
